metadataRaw.title: Best Core Strengthening Exercises for Seniors
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows straightforward exercises focused on improving strength and stability in the core muscles.

These exercises are designed for seniors, so we'll keep it simple with no awkward or complex movements. They're prefect to do daily. 

As a bonus, all of these exercises can be done without any equipment.

Watch now for easy core strengthening exercises for seniors (and beginners)!

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:46 Pedaling Dead-Bug
3:27 Chair Exercise
7:20 Bird Dog
9:15 Pelvic Bridge
